lines.text: It could pull me up in one second. So why did it *wait?*
lines.style: Young man, fast and breathless, terrified, no pauses, the question shot out sharp.

lines.text: Every rung I climbed, a floor below me went *dark.*
lines.style: Young man, quick and tense, rising fear, the last word hard.

lines.text: Halfway up, one of my own lights went *out.*
lines.style: Young man, sharp gasp, scared, fast.

lines.text: Then it leaned down... and I saw its *arm.*
lines.style: Young man, whisper, slow and frozen with fear.

lines.text: Tally marks. Twelve hundred of them. Like the ones in my *elevator.*
lines.style: Young man, hushed disbelief, slow, realisation growing.

lines.text: It wasn't hunting me. It was the first *Theo.*
lines.style: Young man, quiet, shocked, broken realisation, the last word heavy and slow.

lines.text: Take his place... or push him *down?*
lines.style: Young man, panicking, fast and desperate, torn between two choices.
Young man, urgent and direct, straight to the viewer, short.

music.title: Floor 0 - The First Theo
music.style: Horror thriller score. Starts instantly on a loud shimmering stinger and a deep breathing drone, steady climbing rhythm of metal creaks, lights switching off with heavy clunks one after another, a glass bulb bursting, then a slow cold descending string line, a lonely detuned music box, a sad eerie swell of realisation, racing heartbeat and ticking to a sudden cut. Instrumental only, no vocals, mixed to sit under a voiceover.
